narr: A stationary front stalled out along the Ohio Valley contributing to a warm and humid airmass. Showers and thunderstorms developed along this frontal boundary and some storms produced damaging winds.
ev: Southern sections of the Lees Creek Road sustained partial washouts and had debris pile up with rushing water.
Rushing water deposited debris over Marly Ingles Highway, north of Ripley Road and south of Tuckahoe Road.
